referenceTable.title: Selected Solubility Information
referenceTable.note: Excludes ions typically required from memory: Group 1 cations, NH₄⁺, NO₃⁻, and acetate are soluble.

cells: Ag⁺, Pb²⁺, Hg₂²⁺, Ca²⁺, Sr²⁺, Ba²⁺

questions.explanation: AgBr is insoluble (Ag⁺ with Br⁻). KNO₃ is a real compound — the other molecular product — but it is soluble, so it stays as spectator K⁺ and NO₃⁻. Those cancel. The net ionic equation is Ag⁺ + Br⁻ → AgBr(s).
